subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Timid
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Bold'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "timid"** means showing a lack of courage, confidence, or assertiveness; easily frightened or hesitant in the face of challenges or risks.(डरपोक)
 
• **Bold:** This word means showing courage or confidence, willing to take risks or confront challenges.(साहसिक)
 
• It is the** opposite of timid**, making it the **correct antonym** in this context.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: **'Bold'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the other given words:
 
 
• **Diffident:** This word means lacking confidence or being hesitant and self-doubting. (आत्मविश्वासहीन)
 
• **Shy:** This word describes a tendency to be reserved or uncomfortable in social situations.(शर्मीला)
 
• **Fearful:** This word means feeling afraid or having a strong sense of fear.(भयभीत)

The correct answer is 'Option 1
